The "best" AI visibility or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) tracking tool depends heavily on your budget, whether you manage a single brand or multiple clients, and if you are already using traditional SEO software.

Currently, Semrush, Peec AI, and Profound lead the market across different use cases for tracking how often your brand is cited or mentioned across LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. [4](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tool/) [7](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DMPSZw75vko)

## Quick Comparison of Top AI Visibility Tools

Tool | Best For | Key Strengths | Considerations
--- | --- | --- | ---
Semrush AI Toolkit | All-in-one SEO & GEO | Bridges traditional SEO with AI search monitoring; great competitor benchmarking. | Doesn't cover as many standalone LLM models.
Peec AI | Agencies & Scale | Built by SEO veterans; excellent multi-client setups and deep citation gap analytics. | Focused purely on tracking; requires separate tools to execute fixes.
Profound | Enterprise Depth | Highly advanced prompt analytics, compliance tracking, and ROI/traffic modeling. | Higher price point; requires structured onboarding.
Otterly.AI | Startups & Solopreneurs | Very affordable entry-level pricing; straightforward brand mention tracking. | Tight limits on prompt volume at lower tiers.
Scrunch AI | Actionable Insights | Segment prompts by buyer persona; real-time manual data refreshes. | No free trial available.

## 1. Semrush AI Toolkit — Best for Integrated SEO teams

If your team is already standardized on Semrush, adding their AI tracking is the most logical choice. It calculates an "AI Visibility Score" and monitors your brand across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini. [3](https://kime.ai/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools) [11](https://www.stylefactoryproductions.com/blog/best-seo-ai-visibility-tools) [10](https://exposureninja.com/blog/best-ai-search-visibility-tools/)

- Pros: Blends keyword research, backlinks, and traditional SEO tracking with AI sentiment mapping.
- Cons: Might lack the granular prompt-level depth found in specialized, standalone GEO platforms.

## 2. Peec AI — Best for Marketing Agencies

For agencies managing multiple accounts, Peec AI shines with its ability to cluster large batches of text prompts and run daily multi-model checks. It helps you visualize your clients' exact share of voice relative to competitors in natural, conversational contexts. [2](https://www.position.digital/blog/best-ai-visibility-tracking-tools/)

- Pros: Highly intuitive dashboard; includes "pitch project" capabilities to help agencies sell AI optimization services to prospects.
- Cons: Premium pricing structure that scales up sharply with high prompt volumes.

## 3. Profound — Best for Enterprise Brands

Profound treats LLM outputs like a dynamic ecosystem rather than a static ranking page. It is engineered for large corporations that need to uncover untapped prompts, look for compliance gaps, and audit brand sentiment across an enterprise scale. [6](https://wpengine.com/blog/ai-visibility-tracking-tools/) [8](https://www.usegrowthos.com/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools)

- Pros: Deep content-gap identification and advanced analytics.
- Cons: Long sales and setup cycle; less accessible for smaller budgets.

## 4. Otterly.AI — Best for Tight Budgets

If you are a solo founder or small business just trying to get a baseline on where you stand, Otterly.AI offers an incredibly accessible entry point. Starting at a budget-friendly tier, it scans core engines like ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

- Pros: Cheap, clean, and requires almost zero onboarding to get moving.
- Cons: Strictly limited to a small number of daily trackable prompts unless you upgrade.
